note: Layout and captions for the Play screenshots and feature graphics. tools/compose.mjs reads this file. Screens come from ../raw/, cast heads from ../raw/cast/, night plates from ../graphics/source/bg/. Crop boxes are in raw pixels [x, y, width, height] of the 1233x2193 render. A card lifts the same box out of the screen at a larger scale, straight, with no rotation. Title lines split on \n, and the {hl} part takes the accent colour.

sub.en-US: The phone app for Seira on your computer.
sub.id-ID: Aplikasi ponsel untuk Seira di komputermu.

alt.en-US: Seira home screen on a phone: the team of bots, and chats that need you first.
alt.id-ID: Layar utama Seira di ponsel: tim bot, dan chat yang perlu kamu jawab di urutan atas.

sub.en-US: Allow or deny the step right in the chat.
sub.id-ID: Izinkan atau tolak langkahnya langsung di chat.

alt.en-US: A chat where the bot Scout asks to send a reminder email, with Allow and Deny buttons.
alt.id-ID: Chat saat bot Scout minta izin mengirim email pengingat, dengan tombol Allow dan Deny.

title.en-US:
See who {needs you}
at a glance

sub.en-US: While Seira is open, one notification shows the bot that needs you most.
sub.id-ID: Selama Seira terbuka, satu notifikasi menampilkan bot yang paling perlu kamu.

alt.en-US: An Android notification from the bot Scout that asks for approval, with Deny, Allow once, and Open chat.
alt.id-ID: Notifikasi Android dari bot Scout yang minta persetujuan, dengan Deny, Allow once, dan Open chat.

sub.en-US: Replies arrive live, with tables and formatted text.
sub.id-ID: Balasan tampil saat ditulis, lengkap dengan tabel dan teks rapi.

alt.en-US: A chat where Scout answers with a table of two open invoices and suggests the next step.
alt.id-ID: Chat saat Scout menjawab dengan tabel dua tagihan yang belum lunas dan saran langkah berikutnya.

sub.en-US: Pick a character and style it, or use your own picture.
sub.id-ID: Pilih karakter lalu atur gayanya, atau pakai gambarmu sendiri.

alt.en-US: The avatar editor: a robot head with pink hair, tabs for Seira, Generate, and Upload, and hair choices.
alt.id-ID: Editor avatar: kepala robot berambut merah muda, tab Seira, Generate, dan Upload, serta pilihan rambut.

sub.en-US: Scan the QR code that Seira shows on your computer.
sub.id-ID: Pindai kode QR yang muncul di Seira pada komputermu.

alt.en-US: The pairing screen after a QR scan: a green check and the message You're connected.
alt.id-ID: Layar pemasangan setelah pindai QR: tanda centang hijau dan pesan You're connected.

sub.en-US: Approve, reply, and keep up with your Seira bots from your phone.
sub.id-ID: Setujui, balas, dan pantau bot Seira dari ponselmu.

alt.en-US: Seira: your bots work, you answer. An approval card and a table from a bot chat.
alt.id-ID: Seira: bot kamu bekerja, kamu yang jawab. Kartu persetujuan dan tabel dari chat bot.
